## Dataset

Provide the official dataset name and publisher.

## Official source

Provide the government, academic, or institutional landing page.

## Research relevance

Explain how the data would improve small-business capital-access, economic-development,
fairness, geographic, or validation research.

## Proposed fields

List the variables or geographic identifiers that would be useful.

## License / terms

Describe the public-use terms if known.

## Integration idea

Explain whether the data should be displayed as context, joined geographically, or used
in a separate validation experiment.

Please do not propose private applicant-level financial records through this template.
